1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Duti Eksais (Labuan) 2025.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 November 2025.

Duti eksais

2. Duti eksais hendaklah dilevi atas dan dibayar oleh pengimport berkenaan dengan

barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang diimport masuk ke dalam Labuan atau

diangkut dari kawasan utama kastam ke Labuan pada kadar duti yang dinyatakan dalam

ruang (5) Jadual kepada Perintah Duti Eksais 2025 [P.U. (A) 389/2025].

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Duti Eksais (Labuan) 2022 [P.U. (A) 183/2022] dibatalkan.

EXCISE ACT 1976

EXCISE DUTIES (LABUAN) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 90A(1)(a) of the Excise Act 1976

[Act 176] read together with paragraph 90B(b) of the Act, the Minister makes

the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Excise Duties (Labuan) Order 2025.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2025.

Excise duties

2. Excise duties shall be levied on and paid by the importer in respect of the goods

specified in the Schedule which are imported into Labuan or transported from

the principal customs area to Labuan at the rates of duties specified in column (5)

of the Schedule to the Excise Duties Order 2025 [P.U. (A) 389/2025].

Revocation

3. The Excise Duties (Labuan) Order 2022 [P.U. (A) 183/2022] is revoked.

SCHEDULE

[Paragraph 2]

(1)

No.

(2)

Goods

1. Cigarettes

2. Tobacco products

3. Electronic cigarettes and similar personal electric vaporizing devices

4. Smoking pipes (including pipe bowls)

(1)

No.

(2)

Goods

5. Preparation used for smoking through electronic cigarettes and

electric vaporizing device, in form of liquid or gel, whether or

not containing nicotine

Made 31 October 2025
